name: Bastion
_: Region 2's boss (S5-5, feat/boss-region-2; the owner's design of 2026-10-14, his choice "B - the window" of 2026-10-15), drawn by scripts/boss-r2-art.mjs. The hangar at the centre, wide (five cells: its hull, the core - a three-cell reactor, a salvo launcher - and the doors under it; the escort launches from the doors), a laser cannon each side in an armoured bay beside it, a sliding rail of three guns outside each cannon. A bay's armour - the locked doors' bars - is the row under its whole cannon (the cannon's module, rows 1-3, its armour row 4: between the cannon and the player): locked, shots deflect on it and the cannon above it still fires, its beam from under the armour. The first rail-gun kill on a side slides its rail one pitch inward and opens that side's bay (the cannon amber and hittable: the window, no timer); the second slides the rail over the cannon - if it still stands, invulnerable and firing for good. The doors are locked until every cannon and rail gun is destroyed or covered, then open with a flash and a sound; the core falls last.

palette._: COLPF0 pale steel, COLPF1 mid steel (the row palettes set it per row), COLPF2 the hittable yellow (lights and visors, the core's top third, the open bays' cannons, the opened doors' stripes; the owner's choice O of 2026-10-17: Atari800's PAL $28 is a salmon orange only 38 apart from the orange trim, so the accent moved to $EC), COLPF3 the dark orange bulk (the track, the hangar's hull, the locked bays' and doors' bars).

rowPalette._: feat/boss-order-scale (the owner's choice O, orange + red, 2026-10-17; it replaced the olive of feat/boss-art; colours as Atari800's PAL palette shows them): light from above - COLPF1 the orange trim (hue 1, 143 degrees from the ally steel $88 by the rules tool), $1A on the track, $18 at the guns, $16 at their muzzles, the armour row's steel grey $04 (the locked bars stay grey); COLPF3 the dark orange bulk $12 on the track (row 0) and behind the gate's bars (row 4), red in rows 1-3 - the hazard stripes, the guns' lamps, the core's lower two thirds ($34, deep $32 at its foot: 78-81 apart from the orange trim; its top third is the yellow $EC - the core from yellow to red). Three switches (rows 1, 3, 4). The b3 flash swaps the yellow $EC and the row's COLPF3 (Atari800 RGB distance 181-220).

motion._: Still at position 32: the rails' slides are the only motion (the owner's rule: no mishmash of motions).

escort._: Region 1's cadence (decision AI); the escort launches from the doors (entry 124: the doors' column) and stops when they fall (the block's code).

capped._: Never drawn: both cannons are slot 1, enabled on every tier (decision 8) - no look in the charset.

rails._: The sliding rails (src/hybrid/boss.s BOSS_RAIL): a kill of a rail's front gun slides the rail one pitch inward after delayFrames, one column every framesPerStep frames (the next gun locked until it locks into the front slot); after `positions` slides it covers its cannon and stops. The rail's first kill also opens its cannon's bay (the cannon's cover is the rail's front gun). While the bay is open and its cannon stands, the gun whose fall would cover it pulses every pulseFrames.

foot._: feat/boss-order-scale (decision AX 5, the L): the rail's inner end - a foot in the armour row, `length` cells inward of the bumper (the nose); the slide moves it with the rail, and at the last position it stands in front of the cannon (the cannon's covered look: locked steel above the foot).

hangar._: The doors launch the escort (their flash cueFrames before each) and stop it when they fall. Locked they are barred armour (band.png); the moment they - or a cannon's bay - unlock, the open look (open.png: amber stripes, the lit tower) is drawn and it flashes, the hit's high tone held unlockFrames frames. Once the doors fall, the core's left flank is armoured (its volley's columns cover the rest of its reach).

nozzles._: None on the band (a still ship has no drive), and no phase images in the look tail (phases false): the engine steps the two nozzle codes unseen.
